response_schema.name: policyRule.policyType
response_schema.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

response_schema.name: policyRule.privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: policyRule.privilegedPortalCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

request_body.name: policyRule.privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
request_body.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: list[].privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: policyType
response_schema.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

response_schema.name: postActionTypes
response_schema.description: Indicates that authentication levels have been selected for the Conditional Access rule action when configuring an access policy. The supported value is STEP_UP_AUTH. To learn more, see Configuring Access Policies.

response_schema.name: postActions

response_schema.name: priority
response_schema.description: The priority of the policy rule.

response_schema.name: privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: privilegedPortalCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

request_body.name: privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
request_body.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: policyType
response_schema.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy

response_schema.name: privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: privilegedPortalCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:

  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy

response_schema.name: list[].privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: list[].privilegedPortalCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy

response_schema.name: rules[].privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

response_schema.name: rules[].privilegedPortalCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
The type of capabilities for the privileged portals policy. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_UNINSPECTED_FILE: Allows uninspected files to be displayed in the PRA Portal.
  • DELETE_FILE: Allows the deletion of files.
  • REQUEST_APPROVALS: Allow privileged approval requests to be reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SANDBOX: Allows ZIA Sandbox integration inspection of the file.
  • UPLOAD_INSPECTED_SCAN: Allows inspection via another format other than ZIA Sandbox.

response_schema.name: policyType
response_schema.description:
Specifies the policy type. The supported values are:
  • ACCESS_POLICY or GLOBAL_POLICY: Access policy
  • TIMEOUT_POLICY or REAUTH_POLICY: Timeout policy
  • CLIENT_FORWARDING_POLICY or BYPASS_POLICY: Client forwarding policy
  • INSPECTION_POLICY: AppProtection policy
  • CREDENTIAL_POLICY: Privileged credentials policy
  • CAPABILITIES_POLICY: Privileged capabilities policy
  • ISOLATION_POLICY: Isolation policy
  • CLIENTLESS_SESSION_PROTECTION_POLICY: Browser protection policy
  • REDIRECTION_POLICY: Redirection policy
  • PRIVILEGED_PORTAL_POLICY: Privileged portals policy

response_schema.name: privilegedCapabilities.capabilities
response_schema.description:
Indicates the type of capabilities for the privileged policy. The supported values are:

  • CLIPBOARD_COPY: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Paste function.
  • CLIPBOARD_PASTE: Indicates the PRA Clipboard Copy function.
  • FILE_DOWNLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enable the File Download function.
  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.

  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.

  • FILE_UPLOAD: Indicates the PRA File Transfer capabilities that enables the File Upload function.
  • INSPECT_FILE_DOWNLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and downloads the file following the inspection.
  • INSPECT_FILE_UPLOAD: Inspects the file via ZIA sandbox (if you have set up the ZIA cloud and the Integrations settings) and uploads the file following the inspection.
  • MONITOR_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Monitoring function.
  • RECORD_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Monitoring Capabilities to enable the PRA Session Recording function.
  • SHARE_SESSION: Indicates the PRA Session Control and Monitoring capabilities to enable PRA Session Monitoring.
